search_text: published ZDI-23-717 ZDI-CAN-19527 D-Link D-View uploadFile Directory Traversal Arbitrary File Creation Vulnerability 2023-05-24 CVE-2023-32166 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-32166 8.1 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:H/A:H ['D-Link'] ['D-View'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create arbitrary files on affected installations of D-Link D-View. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the uploadFile function. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create files in the context of SYSTEM. D-Link has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: D-Link D-View uploadFile Directory Traversal Arbitrary File Creation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create arbitrary files on affected installations of D-Link D-View. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the uploadFile function. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create files in the context of SYSTEM.
